## Context / Problem

`tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py:47-69` iterates only names already present in the golden although `docs/api-stability.md:27,30-33` promises compatibility aliases and tombstones. At the audited snapshot, 52 live keys and 53 canonical environment names were absent, so an unregistered addition can later disappear without the removal oracle noticing.

## Approach

Derive the live canonical schema-key and environment-name sets and require both directions: every golden entry is valid and every live canonical name is enrolled. Keep explicit alias and tombstone records as the only accepted removal path. This strengthens the existing golden instead of adding another registry.

## Scope

- `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py`
- the existing config-surface golden data/generator
- canonical config and environment registries only as needed to expose deterministic inventory

## Testing

Exercise missing-live-name, stale-golden-name, explicit-alias, and tombstone controls; regenerate the checked-in golden deterministically.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Adding a live canonical schema key without golden enrollment fails a focused test.
- [ ] Adding a live canonical environment name without golden enrollment fails a focused test.
- [ ] Explicit aliases and tombstones remain accepted and continue to prove removals.
- [ ] The regenerated golden is deterministic and the config-surface suite passes.
